title: Universal Copyright Convention
summary: Wikidata item Q369989, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1952 international copyright treaty that requires copyright notices". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.

retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 11 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1346111431, defines the convention against the Berne Convention and under the auspices of UNESCO; this atlas holds neither, and no copyright or intellectual-property record of any kind. The nearest thing here is the Geneva Act of the Lisbon Agreement on appellations of origin, which the article does not mention and which is a different instrument about a different right.
